trash.title: Trash and versions
trash.subtitle: Deleted items and earlier versions of files are kept in a reserved space on their own volume, and removed after their retention or when that space is needed.
trash.enabled: Send deleted items to the trash
trash.enabledHelp: When off, deleting removes items for good. Items already in the trash still expire.
trash.maxPercentHelp: The most the trash may hold on a volume, from 1 to 90%.
trash.maxSizeHelp: Optional. The smaller of the share and the cap applies.
trash.invalid: Check the values: retention from 1 to 3650 days, share from 1 to 90%, a positive size or none.
trash.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.
trash.environmentNote: Defaults come from TRASH_ENABLED, TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS, TRASH_MAX_PERCENT and TRASH_MAX_SIZE.
trash.zonesSubtitle: Each volume keeps its trash in a hidden .nextexplorer folder at its root, so deleting never copies anything.
trash.zonesEmpty: Nothing has been deleted into a trash yet.
trash.zonesFailed: The volumes' trash could not be loaded.

events.versionEvicted: A version of "{name}" removed to free space
events.versionFailed: A version could not be removed
events.versionLost: A version was missing its content
events.versionTooLarge: "{name}" is larger than the whole space: what it replaced was not kept
events.versionsBreaker: Too many versions missing at once: nothing was changed

versions.title: File versions
versions.subtitle: Each save keeps what it replaces, without copying it, in the same reserved space as the trash. Older versions are thinned out over time.
versions.enabledHelp: Independent of the trash. When off, saves keep nothing new; existing versions stay until they expire or are deleted.
versions.tiersHelp: After these tiers, one version per week is kept. An office editing session leaves one version, plus a checkpoint at most this often. Pinned versions escape the thinning and the per-file limit.
versions.invalid: Check the values: 1 to 720 hours, 1 to 365 days per hour, 1 to 3650 days per day, 1 to 1000 versions per file, a checkpoint from 1 to 1440 minutes.
versions.sharedSpace: Versions and the trash share each volume's reserved space. When it runs short, older versions go first, then trash items, then each file's latest version, and pinned versions last.
versions.environmentNote: Defaults come from VERSIONS_ENABLED, VERSIONS_KEEP_ALL_HOURS, VERSIONS_HOURLY_DAYS, VERSIONS_DAILY_DAYS, VERSIONS_MAX_PER_FILE and VERSIONS_SESSION_CHECKPOINT_MINUTES.

apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.intro: A token lets a script use this server on your behalf, without your password and without a browser. Each one can be taken away on its own, and none of them can change your account or administer the server.
apiTokens.scopeReadHelp: It can list, search and download. It cannot change anything.
apiTokens.scopeWriteHelp: It can do what you can do with files: upload, move, rename, delete.
apiTokens.renamePrompt: A new name for this token

apiTokens.useIt: Send it as this header on every request.
apiTokens.limits: A token is never more than the account it belongs to, and always less: it cannot change your password, add a passkey, issue another token, administer the server or open a terminal. Up to 50 tokens per account.
